issues.legal_issue: Whether the landowner’s failure to obtain a valid change-of-land-use certificate made release of the acquired land impermissible under the applicable government policies.
Whether refusing to release the land, while other lands were released from the same acquisition, constituted unlawful discrimination.
Whether the request for release of land was barred by delay and laches.
Whether the principles of res judicata barred consideration of the request for release of land.
Whether, in the circumstances of the case, compensation should be calculated under the 2013 land acquisition statute as of its commencement.
